page_title: STU 3-1 DAR | Stuttgart v Darmstadt 22/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jovan Milosevic (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Serhou Guirassy.
90+4' The substitution has been made. Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) has replaced Pascal Stenzel.
90+3' No offside! Referee Matthias Jollenbeck points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Stuttgart players celebrate.
90+3' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Matthias Jollenbeck wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
90+3' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
90+2' 3 - 1 GOAL - 3:1! Pascal Stenzel found Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Marcel Schuhen off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
89' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
89' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
87' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Frank Ronstadt (Darmstadt) is coming onto the pitch as Matthias Bader cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt) picks up a yellow card.
86' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
84' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Marcel Schuhen.
81' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

80' Excellent touch by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' A substitution has been made. Enzo Millot is replaced by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
78' Substitution. Chris Fuhrich will be replaced by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).
78' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tim Skarke will be replaced by Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt).
78' Here is a change. Fabian Holland is going off and Torsten Lieberknecht gives the last tactical orders to Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt).
78' Substitution. Mathias Honsak is replaced by Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt).
77' The referee shows the yellow card to Filip Stojilkovic (Darmstadt).
75' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
73' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
71' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is given a yellow card.
70' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
68' Substitution. Silas leaves the pitch and is replaced by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).

67' What an amazing save by Marcel Schuhen! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
66' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a powerful first-time volley towards goal, but the ball goes well wide of the left post.
65' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Stuttgart due to an offside in the build-up play.
64' Wait! Referee Matthias Jollenbeck has indicated he is going to review the Stuttgart goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
63' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the right post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Matthias Jollenbeck didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) dribbles into the box, but Marcel Schuhen is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
57' Alexander Nubel leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Fabian Holland (Darmstadt).
56' PENALTY APPEAL after Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
53' A first-time shot by Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
51' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) swings in a cross from the corner, but Marcel Schuhen reads it well and gathers the ball.
50' The corner kick from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
49' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
47' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) sends a cross into the box, but Marcel Schuhen comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Darmstadt are ruled offside.
46' Half-time substitution. Torsten Lieberknecht decided to make a change. Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) is replaced by Filip Stojilkovic.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the left post.
45+1' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the left post.
43' The resulting corner from Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) is cleared by the defence.

42' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Darmstadt will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
41' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Matthias Jollenbeck blows the whistle, Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for a foul.
36' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
35' Some great controlled play and passing from Stuttgart. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

32' 2 - 1 Brilliant finish! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Chris Fuhrich, then produced a nice strike into the top right corner. The score is 2:1.
31' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen was alert and made a comfortable save.
28' Total attempts – 3:0. 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
27' A lofted cross from Emir Karic (Darmstadt) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
24' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Matthias Jollenbeck signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Stuttgart players celebrate.
23' The Stuttgart players halt their celebrations as referee Matthias Jollenbeck makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
22' 1 - 1 What a hit! Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
21' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) sends a long ball in, but Marcel Schuhen comfortably gathers the ball.
20' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
20' Matthias Jollenbeck has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt).
19' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
19' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Stuttgart.
17' 0 - 1 Own goal! Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 0:1.
13' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
11' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
8' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) receives a yellow card!
6' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
3' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
3' The referee points to the corner flag and Stuttgart will take a corner.
2' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Stuttgart win a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Darmstadt will have the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck will supervise the game today.
